turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at twenty to five, so we have until then. My son found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I'd like to know who decided that and on what basis.
You're welcome. Now the zero, Hale, and the decision behind it.
I'm waiting. You entered a mark against my son without a phone call, and "ok" isn't an explanation.
You called this meeting, Hale, and you're not saying anything. If I don't get an answer in the next minute, I'm walking upstairs to the principal's office.

"Hm." Your own school's procedure, 4.2, says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and I have it printed right here. I'm writing down that you had nothing to say to that, and the principal sees this page today.
